fixedStationCases: A fixed station may work the same rover callsign once per band from each contacted rover grid.
roverCases: A rover may work the same fixed station once per band from each transmitting rover grid.
Rover-to-rover duplicate identity includes both transmitting and contacted grids.
Mode does not create another contact for an otherwise identical four-coordinate key.
officialGridCorrection.pinnedComparatorDifference: The pinned plugins use call plus band only and count received grids per band; they do not model contacted rover grid in duplicate identity or add the rover activated-grid multiplier.

previewDifferences: The pinned plugins test for Band == 2300+ but their shared get_logged_band returns individual canonical numeric values at 13cm and above; the preview deliberately follows the published point table instead of reproducing that executable zero-point defect.
The portable contest band plan represents the pinned comparator bands through 1mm and its submm bucket, while normal-log band authority remains a later activation gate.
Only CW and SSB are admitted; upstream digital mode mapping remains pending.

The original three source-preview identities retain the pinned per-band duplicate behavior. Separate fixed and rover official-grid preview identities model four-coordinate duplicates, and rover previews add activated grids globally; store correction admission, schedules, categories, and worker activation remain pending.
